name: supresencia.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 1 internal link leads to an error.
lesson: Check your own links after each release, and fix or redirect every one that answers 404.
summary: supresencia.com scores 57 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 37 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 69 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 69 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (15 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), and cookies YSC on youtube.com, VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE on youtube.com, VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA on youtube.com,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 69 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 69 pages analyzed.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 467 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
